rules.description: Job methodology version must equal wave methodology version.
job_key must be unique and match versioned generator hash.
Database job membership must reconcile exactly to frozen manifest matrix.
Coordinate eligibility must be resolved before submission; pending/manual_review are not ordinary executable production states.
Structural-water exclusions must not be submitted or encoded as measured zero/nonappearance.
Expected ChatGPT prompt condition must have exactly R1/R2/R3 separate scientific jobs with fresh-context isolation.
At most one scientific observation per deterministic job.
Accepted attempt must belong to the same job as observation.
Attempt numbering should be contiguous from 1 unless documented recovery path.
Returned observation must retain accepted-attempt and raw-response provenance under provider contract.
Retry-exhausted job must terminate explicitly, not remain indefinitely retryable/submitted.
Event chronology must be temporally plausible.
Retained bytes SHA-256 must match ops.raw_blob.sha256.
Accepted raw payload pointer must be resolvable in private Storage.
Storage path must not mutate to bytes with different recorded hash.
Provider/payload/task/capture provenance must be internally consistent.
Same parser version should deterministically reproduce normalized_output_sha256 when populated.
Cost events are nonnegative and append-only.
At least 99.9% of nonzero paid cost events should be attributable to operational/economic-unit context.
Applicable cost events reference provider price version or documented external billing exception.
Unexplained unit-cost drift is warning >10%, error >25%, critical >50%.
